name: Raydium

evidence.detail: Legacy Token program. decimals 6. mintAuthority null and freezeAuthority null, verified against mainnet RPC.
Raydium documents token supply and emissions.

caveats: Third-party scanners flag this token for top-10 holder concentration around 47 percent held across two accounts.
The holding accounts are not tagged in any public label set we could verify, so concentration is reported as UNKNOWN from our side rather than cleared.
Being in this registry confirms identity and archetype. It does not clear the concentration question.
